This update should hopefully fix some issues in Mission 12 of the game!

notes.title: Magnificent-1 Released!
notes.notes:
Heya folks!

Super happy to announce that Magnificent-1 is now live!

Should you find any bugs, do not hesitate to share them in the Bug Reports forum in the community group!

Merry Christmas to You all and stay safe! :)

notes.title: Magnificent-1 Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I am proud to announce that Magnificent-1 will be released on 15th December 2021.

The game will cost 2.99$ on the day of the release featuring 13 story missions and 10 arcade missions!

Developing this game has been quite a journey and I am excited to show off my first ever completed project to a wider audience!

Have a good day and stay safe folks!
